decisions.decision: Building permit at 141 Canterbury Drive signed, subject to the agreed revisions (study and sun room openings over four feet, cased with no doors).

decisions.decision: Board allowed the addition at 425 Leominster Road on condition of four-foot cased openings to the existing office and den; no further additions without septic system upgrade.
decisions.quote: there can be no further additions to this home without the upgrade of the septic system.

budget_items.topic: Board of Health Administrative Assistant funding in balanced and override budgets
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board noted the Administrative Assistant is not funded in its present form in either the balanced or override budget, and at best is funded at 20 hours per week as a combined position.
budget_items.quote: at best, it is funded at 20 hours per week as a combined position.

budget_items.topic: Land board staffing under balanced budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Under the balanced budget, the Board advised each land-board administrative assistant would work 27.5 hours.
budget_items.quote: under the balanced budget this would mean that each administr ative assistant would work 27.5 hours.

budget_items.topic: Land board staffing under override budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Vice-Chairman Perry Jewell stated that if the override passes and positions cannot all be reinstated, each administrative assistant would work 30 hours per week.
budget_items.quote: with each working 30 hours per week.
